name: ua-stolen-phones-data-quality
title: UA Stolen & Lost Phones — Data Quality Edition
description: A normalised, deduplicated and quality-checked derivative of the Ukrainian open dataset of stolen and lost mobile phones published by the National Police of Ukraine on data.gov.ua. Adds record history reconstructed from the portal's revision archive, IMEI normalisation and decomposition, brand/manufacturer/model resolution from a free-text field, and the region of the registering police unit.

resources.name: records
resources.description: One row per register record, with source fields preserved alongside every derived one so each derivation can be audited against its input. Lifecycle dates are the dates the register was READ, not the dates events happened: first_seen_days and disappeared_days give the width of the window each one stands for, and a NULL window is unbounded rather than zero.

resources.name: dict-tac
resources.description: TAC to brand/manufacturer/model, derived solely from the source register by consensus among records sharing a code. Rows contributed by third-party lists are used internally but are not published here.

fields.name: tac
fields.description: Type Allocation Code, the leading 8 digits of an IMEI

fields.name: purity
fields.description: Share of those records agreeing on the brand

resources.name: record-changes
resources.description: Before and after for every value this project altered, with the reason — the audit trail from the published value back to what the source said.

resources.name: snapshots
resources.description: One row per revision the portal published, folded or not: counts, why it was skipped or distrusted, and whether it carried new content. A snapshot dropping more of the register than the elapsed days allow is recorded but never permitted to close anything.

fields.name: disappeared
fields.description: Records this snapshot was trusted to close

fields.name: missing
fields.description: Records absent from it, recorded whether or not they were closed

fields.name: gap_days
fields.description: Days since the previous folded snapshot

fields.name: status
fields.description: folded, duplicate (byte-identical to an earlier revision), skipped or failed

fields.name: content_is_new
fields.description: False for a republication of bytes already seen. Nineteen revisions between 2020-09-28 and 2021-03-29 reissue the file of 2020-09-22.

fields.name: rows_dupe_id
fields.description: Rows dropped because their id repeats inside the same file

fields.name: read_mode
fields.description: direct, or repaired when the file needed fixing to parse

resources.name: observations
resources.description: The dates on which the register was actually read. Republished bytes and distrusted snapshots are excluded, so a row here is a reading rather than a file. No date in this dataset can be more precise than the interval between two of these rows — see docs/source_defects.md.

resources.name: monthly-coverage
resources.description: Every month of the register's life, including the months nobody looked. Read the arrivals column together with is_measured: a zero in an unobserved month means nothing was measured, not that nothing happened. The export was frozen from 2020-09-22 to 2021-03-29.

fields.name: first_seen_here
fields.description: Records read for the first time in this month

fields.name: is_measured
fields.description: False where the register was not read at all that month
